race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
race.verdict: SAN JUANITO finally capitalised on a much reduced mark last time and can overcome a 4 lb raise to double up. There are several other well-treated sorts in here, with Sant Alessio and Urban Road both appealing as the main dangers to the selection. SAN JUANITO SANT ALESSIO (IRE) URBAN ROAD
